predictions: My worst week of the season so far last Wednesday, as I only pulled in a 15-9 record. We now have all the week 1 make-up matches completed too, so the league is fully caught up (and obviously, so are my match picks now). I sit at 49-23 (68.1% correct) through three weeks, which isn't too bad, especially when you consider that I have absolutely zero idea what is going on in B at any moment (but at least I recognized prior to the season that I would be stumped there… I'm now a sad 3-6 in B).

Match of the week: (E Div.) Waddle In, Waddle Out @ Cheap Shots. If the Ducks had been able to snag one more doubles last week, we would be looking at huge undefeated matchup here. Even with the loss though, this match is still very important, as these are two of the only three E teams that don't already have two losses. If the Cheapies win, the top two in E already have a two-match lead! Cheapies it is, 13-11.

Match #2: (A Div.) Fringe Prime @ Talladega Flights. With Show Me dropping some thunder already, it appears that the big three in A might well now be a big four. Matches within that quartet will obviously be huge in deciding the best of the best in RDL, and this pairing basically lives in that group. Fringe has been just a step ahead of Talladega for what feels like quite a while, but the Flights are on fire. Talladega, 13-11.

Match #3: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Death Throw. The Dartifacts have yet to drop a match, so taking a second loss this early will make the title chase tough. Both the Shooters and DT sit in the trio of 2-1 squads trying to keep pace, making this a critical early season matchup. This is a super tough call, and I feel like it's going the distance. DT in 1001.

Match #4: (B Div.) Raging Bulls @ Hump Day! In the hot mess that is B, five teams lead the way with one loss so far. I would say this match is big, but at this point it seems like every B match is big, soooo…. duh. I feel like I'm dooming whoever I pick. Sorry, Raging, it's you. 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ One Dart Wonders. D has already shaken into four pairs at 3-0, 2-1, 1-2, 0-3. These two are the 2-1 teams, so the winner stays right behind the leaders, while the loser falls back to 0.500. Big deal here. This is another super tough one. Possee, 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Wing & A Plaque @ One Armed Bandits. Four one- loss teams sit within easy reach of the C leaders. Here, the Bandits (1-loss chase team) get their shot at Wing (the leaders). Seems like a pick-the-Wings-until-someone-figures-them-out situation. 15-9.

Match #7: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Heart of Dartness. Undefeated team averaging 20 per week against a team losing two thirds of their matches. Blowout city, right? Uh, not so fast… Salute is averaging 11 points against tough opponents. Dartness wins, but only 14-10.

Matches #8 & #9: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Runs with Corks; Bangin The Wire @ Rippin Darts. With a couple teams racing way ahead (and a third right behind them), the time is now for the bottom five times in E to make a move if they want to be part of the season- long race. The Corks popped a great win last week, but I'm feeling Ton 80 tonight, 13-11. And can I really pick winless Bangin a 4th painful week in a row, 13-11? Somehow I can?! What am I doing?

Match #10: (B Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Double In Stumble Out. The Mafia just managed their first win… and they're only one match out of first because this is the craziness known as B! Alas, I think Stumble's stumble was a single-week event. Stumble Out, 14-10.

Match #11: (A Div.) Inconsistently Consistent @ Darty Minds. It might be a little to talk about earning a chance to stay in A, but I think this match is an early critical one in that story. Darty, 16-8.
Match #12: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Nine Lives. Yep, these two are a combined 2-3 so far. But they also have a combined ave. of 12 points per match. Definitely still in the hunt. McGavin, 13-11.
